faqs.q: Sec. 78-78. - Bond limitations and details; amount of bonds.
faqs.a:
All bonds issued under this article shall be issued by the finance director upon estimates
               of the engineer, or, if bonds are issued after the levy of assessments, in an aggregate
               principal amount not exceeding the aggregate amount of unpaid assessments pledged
               for the payment of the bonds, and upon order of the city manager, approved by the
               council; and the finance director shall preserve the same in a suitable book kept
               for the purpose.
(Code 1981, § 27-79; Ord. No. 551, § 29(A), 5-14-1964; Ord. No. 636, § 2, 9-6-1966)
